outcome: postoperative complications (Clavien-Dindo grade II or greater)
cohort: 2792 patients who underwent hysterectomy for a benign indication
finding: Previous cesarean delivery, higher American Society of Anesthesiologists class, preoperative anemia, and laparotomic approach were associated with increased odds of postoperative complications, while perioperative complications, preoperative anemia, and vaginal or laparotomic approach were associated with increased odds of emergency room visit or readmission to hospital.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean delivery was associated with increased odds of postoperative complications.
